attorneys: Stephen B. Narin for appellants. David Berger for Brown et al., and Arthur Littleton for Pennsylvania Retailers’ Association, appellees.

opinions.text: Appeal from the United States District Court for the Eastern District of Pennsylvania. (Probable jurisdiction noted, 362 U. S. 987.) The motion to substitute Albert N. Brown in the place of Thomas J. Gibbons as a party appellee and to correct and amend title and caption to show Pennsylvania Retailers’ Association as a party appellee is granted.
